d: Long, straight scarlet hair with blunt bangs frames a youthful, mature face featuring narrow, gold-colored eyes and a calm expression. This slender build is dressed in a tactical ensemble consisting of a black form-fitting top, a white sleeveless surcoat, and a dark grey utility belt with pouches, all layered under a large black hooded cloak. Signature details include thin-rimmed circular glasses, a black headset with a boom microphone, a gold chain necklace with a circular pendant, and a white cigarette held in the mouth.
